headlines.snippet: The IDF will begin examining the awarding of commendations and decorations for the battles of October 7th. A commanders' meeting to launch the process will be held next Wednesday, led by the Head of the Manpower Directorate and the President of the Military Court of Appeals. The IDF clarified that the goal is to grant due recognition to exceptional acts of heroism and preserve the combat heritage. Bereaved families have been updated regarding the move, and acts of heroism by civilians will be forwarded for the President's review.
